answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Water's Edge on Leaf Slime (M), killing it, then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Leaf Slime (S), killing it.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Shinobu - Sanctifying Circle for 4 Block and damage to all three enemies, but it would leave both Leaf Slimes alive.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 4 Block, Electro application, and damage to Twig Slime (S), while leaving 1 Energy unused.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A sufficiently larger attack telegraphed by Twig Slime (S), especially if the Leaf Slimes were not threatening damage or Status cards, could have made Shinobu - Sanctifying Circle preferable for its Block.
